name: USDA FoodData Central
obligations: No share-alike; USDA attribution requested and retained.
formats: Pinned CSV ZIP; JSON/API also available
decision: eligible-source; candidates still need curation/release approval
limitations: Historical US food sample descriptions; separate source IDs do not prove distinct culinary identities.

name: FoodOn
commercial: Allowed under attribution terms for covered material
obligations: Credit FoodOn contributors, link license/source, identify changes; inspect imported SIREN/LanguaL and other lineage before production inclusion. No share-alike in CC BY itself.
languages: Predominantly English; no verified Turkish layer
decision: research-only; excluded from production candidate authorization pending lineage review
limitations: Ontology includes broad concepts, processes, prepared foods and imported terms. Own namespace alone does not establish independent authorship.

name: Open Food Facts
obligations: Attribution and applicable derivative-database share-alike/access obligations; review combination boundaries. Images separately CC BY-SA, not used.
limitations: Branded products and crowd-contributed labels; not a cleaned generic ingredient lexicon.

name: TürKomp
commercial: Separate permission/contract and annual software-use fees indicated
obligations: Written permission restrictions; noncommercial exceptions require attribution and unmodified content. No redistribution permission obtained.
formats: Website; licensed delivery by agreement; no open dump verified
limitations: Useful Turkish composition/reference coverage does not confer rights to copy or combine records.

name: Wikidata
version: Live; no entity revision snapshot acquired
obligations: No share-alike for entities; prose pages are separately CC BY-SA. Preserve QID/revision and references if selected later.
limitations: Identity disambiguation and reference quality require review; a label is not expert terminology approval.

name: TÜRKPATENT GI portal
version: Live register; no bulk snapshot acquired
obligations: Reference-only verification of registration/product identity; do not copy descriptions/images or assume certification of generic ingredients.
decision: reference-only; excluded from bulk candidate pipeline
limitations: Useful regional cheese/grain/condiment evidence; GI specifications differ from generic ingredient identity.

name: TheCocktailDB
version: Live terms; no data snapshot acquired
obligations: API access is not blanket offline database/image permission. Linked terms currently identify TheMealDB.
limitations: Recipe-oriented and brand/ingredient ambiguity; no offline redistribution rights established.
